title: Plant Biodiversity Conservation and Biotechnology
content: Biotechnology greatly enhances the efficacy of plant conservation strategies. Techniques including tissue culture, cryopreservation, and molecular markers hold the options in regeneration, conservation, and genetic assessment of the plant genetic assets. Through cryopreservation, long-ternetic diversity in naturalm conservation programs can store plant germplasm, and this does not lead to the loss of sensitivity, while through tissue culture, large quantities of endangered species of plants can be regenerated. Furthermore, molecular methods allow for the evaluation of population/genotypic variability, which is crucial when it comes to auspices for creating improved adaptability of species. As the rate of biological diversity declines so rapidly, these applications represent essential biotools in establishing and supporting sustainable systems of agriculture and ecosystems. The combination of biotechnology in conserving the natural plant diversity and other conventional approaches is important in the conservation of ecosystems and the management of plant genetic resources for sustainable development.
